name: single_direct_elementwise_kernel
strategy: One FP32 kernel computes softmax[row,col] * grad_output[row] and applies the owner-row one-hot subtraction in the same pass.

correctness.owner_row: subtract grad_output when col equals masked_target_1d[row]
correctness.aliasing: softmax is read-only; active ABI uses distinct buffers

performance_hypothesis: The fused pass removes temporary softmax-update, arange, indexed-subtraction, and separate multiply traffic; each output element performs coalesced softmax/output accesses, with one repeated row grad read.
tradeoffs: The target metadata is redundantly read by every thread in an owner row, and integer division/modulo are used to recover row and column.
